prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1418; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recording is for claim review purposes. Do you understand and consent to being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving on Broadway in Pearland, heading east toward the center of town. Traffic had slowed down because of the light ahead.

Q: What happened next?

A: I came to a stop behind a sedan. I had my foot on the brake and I was completely stopped when a pickup truck hit me from behind. It was a hard impact.

Q: Did you see the pickup coming before it hit you?

A: No. I checked my mirror a second before I stopped, but I didn't see it closing in. I just felt the jolt.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: No, they didn't. My car rocked forward and then back against the seat.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: My neck and upper back are really sore. I have a stiff feeling when I turn my head, and I've had headaches since that day. I went to urgent care that evening and they told me it looked like whiplash.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since then?

A: Yes, I'm going to physical therapy twice a week and my doctor has me on muscle relaxers for now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get back to normal.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. We'll be in touch with next steps.
